scenario: Debating the pros and cons of remote work
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashishwa cyane mu magambo yo mu burenze kugira ngo jagate ubufasha.
Umubare w'amagambo wo kugabanya ibyo birenze; bifashishwa ku mwisho cyangwa mu gitatu cy'ishusho.
Mu gihe kiki bikaba bisobanura 'ibikorwa'.
Bifashishwa kumenya ubushakashatsi.
Ku mwisho cy'ishusho bisobanura 'ariko' cyangwa 'nyamara'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: One clear benefit of remote work is that it can increase your productivity, don't you think?
dialogue.translation: Ibyo ni ubufasha bwinshi bw'akazi k'urupfu ni ko biguma gucura ubushobozi bwawe, ese ubibona?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true for some people. However, I've noticed several issues with it.
dialogue.translation: Ibyo ni byo kuri abantu b'abandi. Nyamara, naje mbonanye ibikorwa byinshi birenze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What kind of issues? I think most problems are similar to those you'd face in an office.
dialogue.translation: Ni ibikorwa biki? Ntekereza ko ibibazo byinshi bihuye n'ibyo ubwenge ubwako buzakubera mu ofisi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, remote work may require a lot of self-discipline. If you don't manage your time well, you'll likely fall behind.
dialogue.translation: Nuko, akazi k'urupfu bigatuma ubishire ubushakashatsi mwinshi. N'ubwo utagutunga neza igihe cyawe, byinshi ko uzaguma inyuma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see your point. But companies should provide proper training and tools to help employees, though.
dialogue.translation: Nibona ibintu byawe. Ariko, ubucuruzi butanga ubufasha bw'ubumenyi n'amabwiriza yo kugabanya abashakire, naho.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, they should. Therefore, it's not just about the employee's effort; the employer also has a role.
dialogue.translation: Yego, byabaye. Kubwo, ntibiri kuri ubushakashatsi bw'umushakire gusa; nyene akazi na we afite ubwoko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. And I believe the flexibility remote work offers is a huge benefit that many people value.
dialogue.translation: Byiza cyane. Kandi ntekereza ko ubushobozi bw'akazi k'urupfu bufasha ni ubufasha bwinshi abantu benshi bashimira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree, as long as we address the issues we mentioned. Then it can work well for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Ndagiye, kugeza ubwo tubaza ibikorwa twavuze. Hanyuma biguma gukorwa neza kuri buri wese.

scenario: Discussing a complex ethical dilemma
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashwa n'umushushanyo: kugumana gutya ikintu.
Mu kontegwa iyi, bishobora gusobanura impamvu cyangwa ingamba zikurikiranywa.
Bishobora gusobanura gushakisha hagati y'ibintu bibiri cyangwa birenga.
Nako bifashwa n'umushushanyo: gutera intebe = gutera intebe.
Akenshi bishiraho umushushanyo: kubyibuza gutya ikintu.
Bishiraho inama cyangwa umushushanyo, si ikiciro cy'umwanya w'umushushanyo.
Birahuye n'ubushishozi cyangwa ubwenge.
Bishobora gusobanura kwihanganira cyangwa kugumana.
Akenshi bishiraho umushushanyo: gutanga gutya ikintu.
Inshingano y'ijambo "result", ariko birashirwa cyane mu kontegwa z'amajyambere cyangwa z'ingamizi.
Bishobora kuba bishyigiki cyangwa bishobora kuba bishobora (ububiko bw'abaturage, mu murimo, n.k.).
Mu magambo yo hagati bishobora gusobanura 'n'ubwo' cyangwa 'n'ubwo'. Ntibishobora gusobanura umwanya w'umushushanyo 'though'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to decide whether to expose the company's mistake, even though it could cause a huge scandal.
dialogue.translation: Dutegereza kubyibuza kandi n'ubwo kugumana ibyaha by'ikigo, n'ubwo bishobora gutanga ububiko bwinshi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a serious ethical concern. But first, let's consider the outcome of each possible choice.
dialogue.translation: Ibyo ni intebe byinshi by'ubushishozi. Ariko ku wa mbere, reka tubyibuze ingamizi z'igishakisho kiki kigiye kuba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: If we ignore it, we might avoid immediate problems, but the long-term damage to our reputation could be worse.
dialogue.translation: Iyo tubihanganira, tuba kugumana ibibazo by'imbaraga, ariko ububiko bw'imbaraga ku buryo bwa kanyaga bishobora kuba bishize.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True. Yet the pressure from the board to keep this quiet is intense. They don't want any legal trouble, despite the risk.
dialogue.translation: Ni by'ukuri. N'ubwo ububiko bw'ubutegetsi bwo kugumana ibyo bishobora gutanga ububiko bwinshi. Ntibishaka ibibazo by'amategeko, kandi n'ubwo ububiko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but our decision should not involve hiding facts that affect public safety. That would be wrong.
dialogue.translation: Nibigiye, ariko igishakisho cyacu ntigishobora gutanga kwihanganira ibintu bitanga ubwoba abaturage. Ibyo bitagira ubushishozi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree. Still, we need to think about the employees who might lose their jobs if we go public. It's a tough dilemma.
dialogue.translation: Ndagiye. Ndetse, dutegereza kubyibuza abashakire bishobora kwihanganira imirimo yabo iyo tubyibuza. Ni ibibazo bikomeye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. But supporting the right cause sometimes means accepting some collateral damage. We can't just please everyone, though.
dialogue.translation: Ni byo birimo. Ariko gutanga ubushishozi bw'urupfu rwa by'ukuri bukeye bishobora gutanga kwihanganira ububiko bw'imbaraga. Ntidushobora kugumana abaturage bose, n'ubwo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's present both sides to the board and let them decide, but we'll make sure our recommendation is clear.
dialogue.translation: Ni byo birimo. Reka tubyibuze ibintu bibiri ku butegetsi kandi rero tubyibuze, ariko tuba kugumana ko igishushanyo cyacu ni byo birimo.

scenario: Analyzing the impact of social media on society
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashishwa kugera icyo kinini cyangwa kugera ibyiza ku cyo kimwe.
Ni ukuntu umuntu ashaka kugenzura.
Abantu bafite ibyishimo byo hagati.
Amakuru yashyizweho, kenshi muri uruhu rw'ibyati.
Ikigereranyo cyangwa ingaruka za kuri kimwe.
Kugira ico gituma ari cyo kintu cy'ingenzi canke cyo kintu kigaragara.
Ibyo bituma byinshi bikorwa.
Bishobora kuboneka canke kumenyeshwa.
Ibyiza cyangwa ibyiza.
Ikindi kuri mbere ariko ntibikuri mbere.
Ibyo bituma abantu bo mu muryango canke mu muryango.
Bifashishwa mu mwishura wo murorero kugira ngo ubushake.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you think social media has a positive effect on our community?
dialogue.translation: Wibuka ko ibiti bya mu muryango byishimiye ingaruka nziza ku muryango wacu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It can, especially when people share useful information, but it also affects our behavior in several ways.
dialogue.translation: Byishimiye, bigaragara ko abantu bashimishije amakuru yoshyizweho, ariko naho byagushishoza igitumo cyacu mu bindimo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And have you seen the data that shows how much time people spend on these platforms?
dialogue.translation: None ko wabonye amakuru yagakusanywa yagakusanywa abantu bagara mu muryango?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it's obvious that we're more connected than ever, though sometimes that connection feels superficial.
dialogue.translation: Yee, bigaragara neza ko turimo turimo, nyamara kenshi icyo kugirana ntidushimiye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, do you think the overall effect is likely to be more harmful than helpful?
dialogue.translation: Bityo, wibuka ko ingaruka zikurikirane zigaragara ko ziboneka kuri mbere?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not sure. It depends on how we use it. For example, it can be a great tool for organizing social movements.
dialogue.translation: Nta niba nta niba. Byumvikana ku kuntu twebwe dusanga. Uyu munsi, byishimiye ingaruka nziza ku muryango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But it also spreads misinformation quickly, which can affect public opinion in a negative way.
dialogue.translation: Ariko naho byashyiraho amakuru yose yose, ibyo bituma byagushishoza ubwoba bw'abantu mu buryo butandukanye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. So we need to be critical and not just accept everything we see. That's the key, though.
dialogue.translation: Ni ko bigaragara. Bityo, dufite kuba dufite ubwoba nta niba nta niba. Ni ko bigaragara ko byose byose.

scenario: Presenting a business proposal
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Gahunda cyangwa umenyi ufite ingorane.
Inyubakwa y'ifaranga irimo ku rubanza.
Mu bikorwa, bishobora gutanga umutwe cyangwa ingingo.
Gahunda y'ibikorwa kugira ngo uburize ingingo.
Kugira ingingo mu buryo bufite uburakari.
Kugira intego yuko ibintu bifite uburakari.
Kinini cyangwa kigaragara kuri buri kintu.
Ibindi bishobora kuba mu gihe kirekire; byinshi bikoreshwa kuri abakiri mu gishushanyo cyangwa ibintu bikomeye.
Byarimo ubu; ubu.
Bikoreshwa kugera ubwoko cyangwa ububiko mu buntu.
Bikorera gutanga ubwoko cyangwa gutanga.
Bikorera gutanga uburyo bwo kugira ubwoko cyangwa gutanga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm here to present our proposal for the new marketing campaign.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse, buri wese. Nda hano kugira ngo nderekereze gahunda yacu kuri kampanya y'ububiko boshya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks. We have a limited budget, so we need to ensure every dollar counts.
dialogue.translation: Murakoze. Dufite inyubakwa y'ifaranga irimo ku rubanza, bityo dukeneye kugira intego yuko buri dola ifite uburakari.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Our strategy focuses on digital ads to reach our target audience more effectively.
dialogue.translation: Mu by'ukuri. Gahunda yacu igaragaza ku gaciro kuri amashini yo ku itara kugira ngo tugere umutwe wacu mu buryo bufite uburakari.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But how can we achieve significant growth with such a small budget?
dialogue.translation: Ariko, gute tugira ingingo kugira uburyo bwo kugira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari n'inyubakwa y'ifaranga irimo ku rubanza?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the budget is small, we can leverage social media, which is popular among our potential clients.
dialogue.translation: Naho inyubakwa y'ifaranga irimo ku rubanza, tugirira uburyo bwo kugira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari kuri media y'ubutumwa, igaragaza ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari mu bantu badufite uburyo bwo kugira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds promising. What about our current campaigns? Should we replace them?
dialogue.translation: Ibyo bikorera kugira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari. Ni iki kigira ku kampanya zacu z'ubu? Ese dusabwa kugira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We'll adjust them, not replace. Therefore, we can maintain brand consistency while testing new ideas.
dialogue.translation: Tuzagira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari, ntibizagira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari. Bityo, tugirira uburyo bwo kugira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari mu buryo bufite uburakari buri gihe tugira ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari kuri ibintu bishya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Alright, I see the potential. Let's discuss this further in our next meeting.
dialogue.translation: Nyene, nigaragaje ubwoko mu buryo bufite uburakari. Reka turondere ibyo mu kaganiro yacu y'iminsi y'iminsi.

scenario: Discussing mental health and wellbeing openly
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashishijwe nk'igisubizo (ubufasha) cyangwa nk'inumero (kuba ufite ubufasha).
Mu mwisubizo wo ku buzima bwa muntu, bishimwa ububura bwo mu mutima cyangwa mu mubiri.
Inumero igaragara; mu kinyejana: improved.
Bifashishijwe kuri ibyishimo cyangwa ibyishimo by'umutima.
Igisubizo bitagaragara; ntibishimwa 'advices'.
Inumero igaragara; mu kinyejana: reduced.
Nk'igikorwa kirangiza umuntu ukeneye kuganira.
Bifashishijwe kugena ubushake cyangwa ubushake bwo mu mutima.

vocabulary.translation: wonyine, mu buryo bwo kuba wonyine
vocabulary.note: Ntukagakondere n'ijambo 'lonely' (kubura kuba wonyine).
Mu magambo yo mu mwisho ishimira 'ariko'.
Bishobora gutanga igihe cyangwa impamvu.
Birangiza uburyo cyangwa uburyo bwo kugenzura ikintu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been feeling a lot of stress lately, but I haven't talked to anyone about it.
dialogue.translation: Nafashe ububura bwinshi mu gihe kenshi, ariko nta wundiye naganiriye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's important to be open about these things. I found that talking to a friend really helps.
dialogue.translation: Ni byihuse kuba wiyungukanye kuri ibintu bibi. Nabanje ko kuganira na mugenzi bifasha cyane.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know, but I don't want to burden anyone. I feel I should handle it alone.
dialogue.translation: Nzi, ariko nta kindi nashaka kugira ku mutima w'umwe. Ndibwira ko nashobora kugenzura wonyine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're not alone, though. Asking for support is a sign of strength, not weakness.
dialogue.translation: Ntabwo uri wonyine, ariko. Kugaba ubufasha ni ishimwe ro kuba ufite ineza, si ububasha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Do you have any advice on how to reduce this feeling of being overwhelmed?
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Ufite icyifuzo kuri uburyo bwo guteza ibitekerezo byo kuba wabaye wabaye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, since exercise works well for me, I try to walk every day. It helps improve my mood.
dialogue.translation: Yee, kubera ko gutera imirimo yifasha, nshaka kwambuka buri munsi. Ifasha kugucungura umwete wanjye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've heard that, but I never seem to find the time. Maybe I can go through a simple routine at home.
dialogue.translation: Nabwo mwandikiwe, ariko si ico nashobora kugenzura. Byari byo kuba nashobora guteganywa n'uburyo bwinshi mu ruhande.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a good start. Just remember, you don't have to face this alone, and there's always support available.
dialogue.translation: Ni uburyo bwinshi bwo kugenzura. Ntekereza, nta kindi wigenzura wonyine, kandi hari ubufasha bwihariye.

scenario: Talking about urban vs rural living
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.translation: birimo abantu benshi, birimo abantu benshi

vocabulary.note: Uso al final de la frase para contrastar

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After living in the city for five years, I'm seriously thinking about moving outside the urban area.
dialogue.translation: Nyuma yokuja mu mugi kamezi makumyabiri, ntekereza neza ko nzajya hafi y'ibintu by'umugi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? I find cities quite convenient — you have access to everything you need within a short walk.
dialogue.translation: Ni by'ukuri? Ntekereza ko magere y'umugi ari neza kandi ibiri ngombwa, unashobora kwishyura ibintu byose wishyuye mu gihondo kirekire.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but the constant noise and crowded streets drain me. I want a more peaceful environment.
dialogue.translation: Ni ukuri, ariko ubwenge bw'amajwi n'ibintu byinshi by'abantu birimo birashaka kubwibuka. Ndashaka ibintu by'uruhije.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. However, rural areas often lack basic facilities like hospitals or good schools.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereza. Naho, ibintu by'umudugudu birashaka ibikorwa nka zinda cyangwa amashuri meza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a fair point. But with remote work, I don't depend on the city for my job anymore.
dialogue.translation: Ni ikibazo gihuye. Ariko n'ubushakashatsi bw'ubucuruzi, ntagushyirwa ho ku mugi kugirango njye nshobore gukora.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What about social life and career opportunity? You might feel isolated after a while, though.
dialogue.translation: Kuki ubuzima n'ikibazo cy'ubucuruzi? Woshobora kwemera ububasha nyuma y'igihe kirekire, naho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've considered that. But the cost of housing in the city is insane — I can't afford a decent place anymore.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereye ko. Ariko ubushinge bw'ubucuruzi mu mugi ni by'ubushakashatsi, ntagushobora gutanga ingo meza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right, it's a real trade-off. Perhaps a small town outside the city could give you the best of both worlds.
dialogue.translation: Wihuye, ni ikibazo gihuye. Byari byo kuba umudugudu kirekire hafi y'umugi ukwishyura ibintu by'ibiremwa.

scenario: Negotiating a salary or contract term
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Mu cyamajuro, bishobora gushyirwa ku igishushanyo cyo gushakisha umukono cyangwa igiciro.
Bishobora kuba transitivo (gucungura ikintu) cyangwa intransitivo.
Bishyirwa na prepozisyon 'with' (kwihanganira na wundi).
Ibanga ikintu gihuye n'uko gitegekanijwe cyangwa gikwiriye.
Mu gushakisha, bishobora kuba ubufasha bwinshi nk'ubwubwanwa cyangwa amahamya.
Bishobora kuba mu binyacumu kugira ngo vugwa ibyago byo kwiyandikisha.
Kugira ngo wishimire igishushanyo cyangwa igishushanyo.
Ibanga ubushakashatsi cyangwa ubwibone.
Bishyirwa ku ububiko bw'ifaranga, haba haba.
Bishobora gutanga cyangwa gutanga ikintu.
Bishyirwa kugira ngo ibintu bishobora kuba mu ikintu kinini.
Bishyirwa ku mwishikuri w'ijambo kugira ngo uburere, nk'uko 'noneho'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you for the offer, but I’d like to negotiate the salary.
dialogue.translation: Murakoze kwishimira igishushanyo, ariko nashaka kwihanganira igiciro.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We think the amount we proposed is reasonable, though.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Dukumva ko ububiko twateye ni iranga, naho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but I’d like a 10% increase because the position requires more responsibility.
dialogue.translation: Nibuka, ariko nashaka gucungura 10% kubera ko ubwoko bushaka ubushakashatsi munini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we can adjust the salary if you accept a longer contract term.
dialogue.translation: Byari twebwe dufite ubushakashatsi bw'igiciro n'ubwenge, n'ubwenge bw'ubushakashatsi bw'ubushakashatsi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That could work, but please include a clause about annual reviews in the conditions.
dialogue.translation: Ibyo bishobora gukora, ariko niba ubona ubwenge bw'ibyo bitanga mu mibare.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We can do that. Also, we’ll add a health benefit package to the offer.
dialogue.translation: Dufite ubushakashatsi. Nanone, tuzanira ubufasha bw'ubuzima mu gishushanyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. If the benefit package is included, I’ll accept the terms.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. N'ubwenge bw'ubufasha bwinshi, nizashimira imibare.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I’ll send the final contract for you to review.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Nizamanura kwandika ubwoko bw'ubushakashatsi bw'ubushakashatsi.

scenario: Debating environmental policy with a peer
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Birahinduka kuri cyaba cyangwa cyihariye kuba cyihariye.
Ibindi by'amategeko cyangwa mikorere y'igikorwa, hano muri porogozi cyangwa mu muryango.
Igihe kigeze kuri urupapuro rwo kwinjirira.
Ububiko bwa kintu; muri uwu mwicaro, ububiko bwa inguvu.
Igiciro cyangwa ikorera; bigaragara mu bihe by'amafaranga cyangwa mu bindi bindi.
Igihe kigeze kuri ubwoko bw'ibidukikije cyangwa bw'ibidukikije.
Ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi cyangwa ubucuruzi.
Igihe kigeze kuri urupapuro rwo kwinjirira no kwemererwa.
Kugirwa mu igisubizo cyangwa mu kuri kugira ububiko bw'ububiko.
Igikorwa cy'ububiko; bigaragara ku mwishura cyangwa mu kanya k'urupapuro.
Kugira ububiko bw'ububiko cyangwa ububiko.
Igikorwa cy'ububiko cy'ububiko; bigaragara igisubizo cy'ububiko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue with the new policy is that it's too expensive for small businesses.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereza ko ububiko bw'ububiko bw'ububiko bw'ububiko ni ukubera ko bigaragara amafaranga menshi kuri abakire.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But we have to reduce our emissions somehow. The environment is at stake, and we can't just ignore that.
dialogue.translation: Ariko turatekereza kugira ububiko bw'ububiko bwacu. Ubwoko bw'ibidukikije ni ubwoko, nta n'ubwo dutegereza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but the cost of switching to renewable sources will hurt the industry in the short term.
dialogue.translation: Ndagiye, ariko igiciro cyo gutwara ububiko bw'ububiko bw'ububiko bw'ububiko ni kuba igiciro mu bihe by'ubucuruzi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: However, if we delay, the long-term damage will be even worse. We need to act now.
dialogue.translation: Ariko, n'ubwo tubura, igiciro cy'ububiko bw'ububiko ni kuba igiciro cy'ububiko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but are you against any kind of compromise? Maybe we can phase in the changes slowly.
dialogue.translation: Ni by'ukuri, ariko ese wihuye kuri ububiko bw'ububiko? Byari byo kuba byinshi kugira ububiko bw'ububiko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not against compromise, but the current plan is too weak. Although I understand your concern about jobs, we need stricter targets.
dialogue.translation: Nta n'ubwo nihuye kuri ububiko, ariko igikorwa cy'ububiko ni cyo kuba cyihariye. Ndagiye ntekereza ko wihuye kuri ububiko bw'ububiko, ariko turatekereza kugira ububiko bw'ububiko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I still think it's a risky move. The economic impact is likely to be severe, especially for rural areas.
dialogue.translation: Byari byo kuba byinshi, ntekereza ko ni ububiko bw'ububiko. Ububiko bw'ububiko ni kuba igiciro cy'ububiko, byinshi kuri ibidukikije.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That experience taught me to continue even when things get hard.
dialogue.translation: Ni ko kuri. Ubumenyi bwange bwaranyinjije gutunganya nka kugira ubwoba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I feel the same. It was a period of personal growth for both of us.
dialogue.translation: Ntekanye n'ubwokohebu. Byari igihe cyo kwigisha mu mico kuri twe bose.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Indeed. Looking back, I am grateful for the whole journey.
dialogue.translation: Byaba. Kubura kuva, ndakwibuka neza kuri urugendo rwose.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So am I. We should talk about it more often, but perhaps not today.
dialogue.translation: Nanjye no kuba. Dusaba kuganira byinshi, ariko si ngo nu.

scenario: Discussing the role of humor in communication
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ikorwa kugena ubushobozi bw'ikintu cyangwa ubushobozi bwacyo.
Gutanga ikintu cyo kugenwa cyangwa kwihindura umuntu/ikintu.
Mu muryango, bikwiye 'gutangira' (to seem) cyangwa 'kubura' (to show up).
Gutegura ikibazo cyangwa imiryango mu njera idatunganye.
Ibyo bishobora kugerwaho ntihabire cyangwa byaba bisanzwe.
Kugumana no kugabanya ikintu (ububiko, umwete, n.k).
Ibyo bituma amaherezo nziza cyangwa ubwoba bwiza.
Ibyo bituma ikintu kishobora kugerwaho.
Ikorwa kugena ubushobozi bw'ikibazo (byinshi) cyangwa kushushanya ubushake (ahubwo).
Ibyo bituma ikintu kihagije hejuru y'ububiko cyangwa umubare.
Mu magambo yo hagati, bikwiye 'ariko' cyangwa 'nyamara'. (Note: ntibiyongerewe nk'ubwoko).
Ibyo bituma ikintu gishobora kugerwaho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think humor has a huge impact on communication, but its success depends on the degree of trust between people.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereza ko ubwoba bwfite ubushake bwokwemeza ubwoba mu muryango, ariko ubushake bwacyo bukaze kuri igice cyo kwizera hagati y'abantu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. If you don't know someone well, you should avoid jokes that could be misinterpreted.
dialogue.translation: Byihuse. N'ubwo utazi neza umuntu, wowe wihindura amajwi yoshobora guhindurwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. A joke might appear funny to you, but it can seem offensive to the other person.
dialogue.translation: Ndetse. Ijwi rishobora gutangira kuba iri kuri wowe, ariko rishobora kubura kuba iri kuri umuntu wundi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, how do you approach humor at work, then? I find that a light joke can make the atmosphere more positive.
dialogue.translation: Bityo, otegura gute ubwoba mu gikorwa? Nshobora kubona ko ijwi riri kuri wowe rishobora gutuma ubwoba buri mu muryango buri nziza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to use it, but the immediate reaction is not always good. Sometimes people just stare at you.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kugirira, ariko ubushake bwihutiranye ntibubusa. Igihe abantu bashaka kugira ubwoba, bashobora kugira ubwoba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right. I think the key is to maintain a balance. Don't force it, and read the room first.
dialogue.translation: Ndetse. Ntekereza ko ubushake bwihanganira ubushake. Ntushimagize, maze ubone ubwoba bwihutiranye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. If you do it too often, your colleagues will likely stop taking you seriously, though.
dialogue.translation: Ndetse. N'ubwo ubikoraho byinshi, abashakanye bawe bashobora kugira ubwoba, ariko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, humor is rather powerful. It goes beyond simple laughter. It builds bonds, but unless you are careful, it can also break them.
dialogue.translation: Yee, ubwoba buri byinshi. Bihagije hejuru y'ubwoba bwihutiranye. Bihanga ubushake, ariko keretse ubishimiye, ubwoba nbukwiye.

scenario: Presenting a research finding
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ikorwa kugirango ibireke kuri ubwoko bwo kuduza ko ikimenyetso gishobora gutangwa no kugira inguvu.
Ikorwa byuzuye mu ngingo za gishushanyo mu Icyongereza.
Verbe iryame, itondeka na -yze (ubwoko bw'Amerika).
Mu gishushanyo, igishushanyo cy'abantu canke ibintu bikorwa.
Ikorwa na 'to': similar to.
Ikorwa na 'to' canke 'with'.
Ikorwa byinshi: results.
Mu isaha, ibireme byerekana ibintu bikorwa no kwigira iby'abandi.
Ikigeragezo cy'ubwoko bw'uburyo bwo kugenda canke kwimura.
Ijambo ry'uburyo, rikoresha umubare.
Ikorwa na 'to': according to.
Ikorwa kugirango igishushanyo canke igishushanyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've finished analyzing the data from our latest survey. Do you want to see the results?
dialogue.translation: Nafashe gukora kwishyura ibyerekeranye n'ibyo twakoranye mu gishushanyo cyakabaje. Ushaka kubona amajambo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, please! Did you compare the responses from the two different age groups?
dialogue.translation: Yego, niba ushaka! Wahishuriye ibyerekeranye n'ibyo bishushanyo bya muryango w'ubugeni bw'ubwoko bw'ubwoko?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. According to the initial figures, the younger group shows a significant increase in usage.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Kubera ibyerekeranye n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubuvukanyi, igishushanyo cy'abana bikorana amajambo menshi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's interesting. Did you observe any other notable patterns in that sample?
dialogue.translation: Ibyo ni by'ingenzi. Wahishuriye ibyerekeranye n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko mu gishushanyo cy'ubwoko bw'ubwoko?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we saw a clear trend: the older group's numbers remained stable, although they started from a higher point.
dialogue.translation: Yego, twabonye ikigeragezo cy'ubwoko bw'ubwoko: amajambo y'ubwoko bw'ubwoko bw'ubwoko bwararirijwe, nyamara bwarashyizwe mu kigeragezo cy'ubwoko bw'ubwoko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So the findings are quite similar to last year's study, but with a sharper contrast in the younger demographic.
dialogue.translation: Ibyo birebana n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko, ariko n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko bw'ubwoko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. This clearly demonstrates that our new approach is working as intended.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Ibyo birebana n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko, ariko n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Excellent. Let's prepare the final report and present these findings to the team tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Tugishushanye ibyerekeranye n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko, ariko n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko.

key_phrases.translation: iby'ingenzi birebana n'ibyo bishushanyo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko

scenario: Discussing inequality and social mobility
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Niba akajya k'urupfu rwawe no ku mpamvu z'ubucuruzi.
Ububiko bukwiye canke ububiko bukwiye kuri buri kintu, hano kuri abahinzi n'abanyagihanga.
Ibiherero byiza kugira ico ushaka.
Ubumenyi bw'umuryango canke bw'ubwoko bw'umuntu.
Ibimenyetso by'ububiko; bishobora kwinjirwa na nomero canke na gerundio.
Ubuhamya bwo kugira ico ushaka.
Ubuhamya bwo kugira ububiko.
Gutegura ico ushaka.
Gutegura ubushake kugira ico ushaka.
Gutegura canke gutegura kuri ubwoko.
Igihe kigiye kuri ubwoko.
Ubushake bw'ubucuruzi canke bw'ubucuruzi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been reading about the income gap in our country, and it's shocking how wide it has become.
dialogue.translation: Nafitiye gutanga iby'ububiko bw'ubucuruzi mu gihugu cyacu, kandi nifite ubwoba niba ububiko bwo kugira ico ushaka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but the real problem is the lack of opportunity for those from a poor background to improve their situation.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ariko ubwoba bw'ubwoko bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Despite all the talk about equal rights, many people still struggle to get a decent job.
dialogue.translation: Niba ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi, abantu benshi baragiye gutegura ubushake kugira ico ushaka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Therefore, social mobility is almost impossible for them; they remain stuck in the same class.
dialogue.translation: Nuko, ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi, kandi ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: However, I know a few cases where people managed to rise despite their humble beginnings.
dialogue.translation: Ariko, nifite ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi, kandi ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But those are rare exceptions; the wealth is concentrated in a few hands, and that's the core issue.
dialogue.translation: Ariko ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi, kandi ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, what can we do to change this? Maybe better education is the answer.
dialogue.translation: Nuko, iki cyo kugira ico ushaka? Ubuhamya bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Education helps, but we also need policies that directly address the gap, otherwise nothing will really change.
dialogue.translation: Ubuhamya bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi, ariko ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubucuruzi, kandi ubwoba bw'ubucuruzi.

scenario: Talking about leadership styles
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bikoreshwa kugena umutwe w'igikorwa cyangwa umukingo.
Uburyo bukwiye bukukora ikintu.
Gutanga neza ibintu byuzwe kugenzwa.
Kushyirira ishyamba cyangwa gutanga umubiri.
Guteza mu makubakubo.
Ikinyamakuru cy'abantu bakoranya hamwe.
Kugena cyangwa kugendera ikinyamakuru.
Ububasha cyangwa ubwami bwo guteza.
Ifite ubushishozi bwo kwihangana n'ibyo bitandukanye.
Ifite ubushishozi, ntibishimira ibyo bitandukanye.
Ububiko bwo kugenzwa cyangwa gutunga ikintu.
Ifite ubushishozi bwo gutanga icyo kibaza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the best way to manage a project is to be flexible with your team.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereza ko uburyo bwa kwanza bwo gushishikira igikorwa ni kuba ifite ubushishozi n'umukingo wawe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But if you're too flexible, people may not take their responsibility seriously.
dialogue.translation: Ariko niba uri ifite ubushishozi, abantu bashobora kuba batagira ububiko bwabo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I prefer to lead by supporting others rather than giving strict orders.
dialogue.translation: Ndashaka kugena n'ubushishozi bwo kushyirira ishyamba abandi kurusha gutanga amabwiriza ifite ubushishozi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In my experience, a leader must have authority and make decisions quickly.
dialogue.translation: Mu byerekeye ubwenge bwange, umugeni wabwenge kuba afite ububasha na guteza neza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the most effective leaders direct without being authoritarian.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ariko abageni b'ubushishozi bashobora kugena neza ntihababasha kuba batabasha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right. A strict style can work, but it may not be the best for every team.
dialogue.translation: Byari kuwa byiza. Style ifite ubushishozi irashobora kugenzwa, ariko ntirashobora kuba byiza ku buri mukingo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. So, how do you usually manage conflict within your team?
dialogue.translation: Byiza. Bityo, oshobora gute gushishikira ubwicanyi mu mukingo wawe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to support each person and give them more responsibility when they're ready.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kushyirira ishyamba buri wese no gutanga ububiko bwabo bwo guteza neza.
